description: Bring-coordinate analysis of the interface linking weight. The 3 H_3 Wedderburn blocks = 3 Bring chart volumes (W_sym, W_std, W_alt). Interface σ₃ monodromy is trivial on sym/alt (|R|≈1) and nontrivial on std. CG decomposition std⊗std = triv+std+sign gives Bring sum q³+2+q⁻³ = 4.10. lw_A × CG/3 = 3.46 (41% off target 5.85). No simple algebraic shortcut closes the gap.

data.conclusion: No algebraic shortcut. Full H_6 interface spectral computation needed.
